name: 01863 · N Chelmsford, MA
findings: ZIP 01863 (N Chelmsford) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01863 (N Chelmsford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01863 (N Chelmsford) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
